title: Practice: delete removes the wrong task
task: I built a to-do app with an AI helper. When I click delete on a task, a different task disappears instead. Please fix the delete button. The UI calls TodoList.delete(item_id) with the id of the task the user clicked.

good_edit.text: In todo.py, delete must find the task whose 'id' field equals item_id and remove that task. Do not use item_id as a list position: ids don't shift after earlier deletions.

checks.test_delete_first_task: Deleting the first task removes that task and no other.
checks.test_delete_after_earlier_delete: Deleting still removes the right task after an earlier delete.
checks.test_delete_last_task: Deleting the last task removes it.
checks.test_delete_middle_after_toggle: Deleting a task in the middle works even after it was ticked.
